instruction: Convert the heron photograph into a 3D model file and export it as an OBJ format for 3D printing.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP is a 2D image editor and does not have capabilities to convert 2D photographs into 3D models. This would require specialized 3D reconstruction software with photogrammetry capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP cannot convert 2D photographs to 3D models
The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically appropriate for impossible tasks
Metadata correctly explains why the task cannot be completed (requires specialized 3D reconstruction/photogrammetry software)
No verification logic is needed since the task is impossible to complete in GIMP
